analysis.scoreReason: RSI 과매도 탈출 + 5일 저가 20일 저가 상회
analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI exiting oversold + 5-day low above 20-day low
analysis.reason: 직전 매수 판단 이후 3거래일 연속 하락했으나, RSI는 과매도 구간에서 탈출하며 31.4 수준으로 상승했다. 5일 저가가 20일 저가(43,985원)를 상회하는 'Higher Low' 패턴이 형성되며 반등 가능성을 시사한다. MACD 히스토그램은 악화 중이나, RSI 회복과 가격 패턴이 우선이다.
analysis.reasonEn: Despite three consecutive days of decline since the last buy signal, the RSI has exited oversold territory and risen to 31.4. A 'Higher Low' pattern is forming, with the 5-day low exceeding the 20-day low of 43,985, suggesting a potential rebound. While the MACD histogram is worsening, the RSI recovery and price pattern take precedence.

[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 47,225) vs SMA5 (KRW 51,952)/SMA20 (KRW 62,255)/SMA50 (KRW 82,643): below short/mid-term trends, bearish zone
· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 100,853)/SMA200 (KRW 112,542): below long-term trends, deepening bearishness
· 52-week position (4.6%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (29.9→31.4) + exiting oversold, confirming upward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-2.7561→-54.6273) + worsening, signal of continued bearishness
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band KRW 42,983) + approaching lower band, rebound expected
[Support & Resistance]
· Swing Support (KRW 41,000) + based on 1.3x ATR lower support
· Swing Resistance (KRW 47,415) + potential for short-term rebound upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (Higher Low) + confirmation of recovery signal
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.27x) + normal reliability of movement
· Current phase diagnosis (attempted rebound within downtrend) + buy entry conditions met
